bound.how: pda ingest --source volcanicashforecast --limit 10. The official MET Volcanicashforecast swagger prints 4 untemplated GET paths that have a last-segment id and no required query parameter. The adapter copies those paths. GET uses the printed /reftimes collection with no invented query filters. /changelog prints RSS and /healthz prints plain text so they stay unused for fetch. /resources prints a JSON array of file paths so it stays unused for this first fetch.
